meta.name: Student Atlas design tokens
meta.purpose: Reference for spacing, type, shape, and control sizes. Not imported by the app. Do not wire these into src/index.css or components until a UI change is requested.
meta.structure: Roles, not the current component tree. A control token can be used by a header, a dialog, or a future screen.
meta.brand: Color keeps Atlas's spirit: periwinkle washes, warm paper, and one royal-blue action. The hex values are a tuned ramp, not the current stylesheet and not the measured site colors. Geometry is taken from the measured sites. Google blue and Claude's dark theme stay in reference only.
meta.grid: 4px space grid. Prefer multiples of 4. Minimum primary target is 40px; 48px for the main action on a page.
sources: Material Design 3 (Classroom app guidance; the signed-in app was behind a school login)

page.note: Page text cream is close to Atlas detail-400. Dark theme is reference only.

bodyLarge.note: Chrome Web Store body. Classroom marketing body is 18px; keep 16px as the app default so density stays practical.

hover.note: Prefer a color or background change. Skip scale-on-hover as a default so neighboring items do not shift.

focus.note: Visible focus ring on every control. Atlas uses a 2px ring today.

analysis.atlasSpirit: Cool periwinkle surfaces, warm paper, and a single royal-blue action. The live stylesheet packs seven blue steps into a narrow light band, and its cream steps jump from neon yellow to quiet ivory.
analysis.chromeWebStore: White cards on a white page, one saturated blue used only for actions and the selected tab, pastel tiles that are not the action color, and near-black text rather than pure black.
analysis.googleClassroom: Titles darker than body copy, a quiet gray for secondary text, outline buttons with a neutral border and a colored label, and a deep blue fill so white type stays readable.
analysis.claude: Page, card, and inset are close but distinct steps of one hue. Borders are faint and in-family. Cream is warm and quiet, not a second accent. One accent color does all the emphasis.
analysis.decision: Keep the periwinkle, paper, and royal-blue roles. Spread the blue wash so steps are visible, calm the cream so it stays warm without glowing, and deepen the action blue just enough for white labels. Do not copy site hex values or the current stylesheet hex values.

100.note: Lightest periwinkle wash. Same role as the pale blue surfaces, with a slightly wider step down to 200.

500.note: Selected chip fill. Still a tint, not the action color.

700.note: Strongest wash. Stays lighter than the action blue so a tint never reads as a button.

100.note: Quiet ivory. Warm paper, without the neon yellow of a fully saturated cream.

300.note: Sand accent. The warmest step, used sparingly the way Claude uses a single accent.

400.note: Page paper. Warm like the cream canvas, closer to white so cards can lift off it.

500.note: Deeper paper for stripes and pressed cream surfaces.

primary.note: Royal blue in the same hue family as the washes, deepened so white text clears about 6:1. Not Google blue and not the lighter stylesheet action color.

primaryPressed.note: Same hue, darker. Press stays in the family instead of switching blues.

text.note: Blue-black ink. Near-black, like the store and Classroom titles, tilted toward the brand hue so it belongs on cream paper.

textSecondary.note: Quieter than titles, still about 5.8:1 on the page. Cool gray, not a borrowed Google gray.

textMuted.note: Hints and inactive chips. About 4.6:1 on the page, the floor for readable gray.

border.note: Faint cool border for outline controls. In the blue family, lighter than a brand wash step.

surface.note: Raised cards. White on cream matches the store's card-on-page lift.

surfacePage.note: Warm paper canvas. Claude's cream is the same idea on the opposite theme: a quiet warm ground, not a second brand color.

surfaceSunken.note: Inset panels. A periwinkle step below the page, the way the store sets panels apart without a new hue.

surfaceMuted.note: Neutral chip ground when a control should not pick up the blue wash.

default.note: Chrome Web Store Sign in: 40px pill, 14px medium. Atlas blue instead of Google blue.

prominent.note: Classroom Contact sales: 48px pill, 24px horizontal padding, 16px medium. Use for the one main action on a page.

compact.note: Claude header Try Claude: 36px, 8px radius, 8px 16px padding. Fits a crowded bar.

default.note: Chrome Web Store See collection: 40px, 24px horizontal padding, 20px radius.

prominent.note: Classroom Sign in to Classroom: 48px pill, 1px gray border, blue label.

text.note: Chrome Web Store text button is 40px with 12px horizontal padding. Use for nav items and low-emphasis actions.

default.note: 40px target. Full radius matches Atlas profile and bookmark icon buttons.

compact.note: Claude submit: 28px, 8px radius, 4px padding. Only inside a field, where the field itself is the target.

chip.note: Filter and grade chips. Full radius like both Google sites. Active fill stays on the Atlas blue scale.

appBar.note: 64px bar. Classroom nav items and Material app bars use this height. Padding grows from 16px to 24px on wide screens.

tab.note: Chrome Web Store tabs: 36px, 16px horizontal padding, 14px/20 medium, 3px indicator.

segmented.note: Claude plan switcher: 44px track, 4px padding, 2px gap, 12px radius. Tabs are 36px with 24px horizontal padding.

rail.note: A side list of sections, resizable. 240px is the current Atlas default. The range lets the rail grow without a new layout.

page.note: Cream canvas for browsing and forms.

card.note: Chrome Web Store panels use 16px radius. Material cards sit in the 12–16px range.

panel.note: Chrome Web Store chart panels: 16px radius, padding 28px 16px 16px, 24px between columns.

panelRoomy.note: Claude pricing cards: 24px radius, 32px padding and gap. For a small set of large choices, not a dense list.

dialog.note: 16px radius keeps dialogs in the same family as cards. 24px padding matches a medium page inset.

callout.note: Inline notice. 12px radius, tighter than a card so it reads as a message, not a section.

search.note: Chrome Web Store search: 44px, 8px radius, 12px left padding, soft shadow.

textarea.note: Same radius and type as text fields. Extra padding because the box is multi-line.

content.note: Claude content is 1440px, Chrome Web Store 1344px, Classroom marketing about 1360px. 1440px is the ceiling. 1280px suits a catalog. 672px suits a single form.

inset.note: Material page inset is 16px compact and 24px medium. 32px is the roomy step Claude uses inside large cards.

stack.note: Vertical rhythm. 24px separates related groups. 32px separates sections, matching Claude card gaps and Chrome Web Store column gaps.

cluster.note: Horizontal gaps. Chips and icon groups use 8px. Toolbars use 12px. Category-style tiles use about 20px (Chrome Web Store measured 21px).
